title: Giants GM Joe Schoen: Jeremiyah Love's an offensive weapon, not just a running back

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants GM Joe Schoen: Jeremiyah Love's an offensive weapon, not just a running back
sources.description: Giants General Manager Joe Schoen will be on the clock with the fifth overall pick of the draft in a little more than a week and his plans for that selection were a chief topic of a Tuesday press conference from the team's facility.
